name: RPi ALERT
tagline: A Raspberry Pi OS for ALERT flood-warning base stations: hears ALERT and ALERT2, decodes every burst, posts it to Flood-Net.
about: Turns a Raspberry Pi into an ALERT and ALERT2 base station. Its Node agent finds RTL-SDR sticks, Quansheng ALERT radios, ELPRO ERT-A2 receivers and a GPS by itself, decodes every burst with Flood-Net's own decoders, keeps readings in a queue on disk and posts them to Flood-Net's ingest. It checks in with Flood-Net's Base Stations tab once a minute, so an administrator can see its health, change its settings and update it from there. A set-up page on GitHub Pages picks the image and writes the SD card's settings, for whoever puts a base station on a site.

status.summary: Version 0.22.0 adds a 288 kHz window between 240 kHz and 960 kHz (Flood-Net's decoder now resamples a rate that is not a whole multiple of 240 kHz): five channels 75 kHz apart fit in it, at three fifths of 960 kHz's work. Its Overview puts the plots at the top, then the counts and the receivers, every setting folded under its card; readings, bursts, Flood-Net's requests and the log each have a tab. 18 Bateson runs one RTL-SDR stick with five channels; the bench test with a V4 stick, a Quansheng radio and an ERT-A2 has not been done.

components.name: Agent daemon and command line
components.what: The rpi-alert daemon and CLI (status, top, setup, request-token, config, remote, access): settings, the SD card's rpi-alert.conf, the clock, the hotspot, the speaker.

components.name: RTL-SDR receiver
components.what: Several channels per stick, each with its own decoder thread; the window planner, tuning help (ppm, gain, carrier offsets), IQ recordings, and the Pi's own ALERT2 AirLink off-air decoder.

components.name: Serial receivers: Quansheng, ERT-A2, GPS
components.what: Finds serial devices by what they send (sniff), then drives Quansheng radios on the v3 or v1 ALERT firmware, ELPRO ERT-A2 receivers and NMEA GPS; reopens them after an unplug.

components.name: Flood-Net's decoders, vendored
components.what: alert-dsp.js, quansheng.js, alert2.js and serial-gps.js copied verbatim from Flood-Net and pinned in SOURCE, so the Pi decodes exactly what the website does.

components.name: Flood-Net uplink and queue
components.what: Posts readings, receivers and every frame heard to Flood-Net's ingest with the Pi's own token, from a disk queue that survives power cuts; requests its token; keeps the station register.

components.name: Remote management and SSH access
components.what: Checks in with Flood-Net's Base Stations tab once a minute and does only the listed verbs it hands back; the alert account's SSH keys from the card, GitHub or Flood-Net's team keys.

components.name: Dashboard and settings page
components.what: The Pi's web page and kiosk: one spectrum and waterfall for every stick, a chart per receiver, a day of history, the Survey page, and every setting.

components.name: OS layer
components.what: install.sh and the one-line bootstrap for an existing Pi; systemd units, udev rules, sudoers, the root helper, the kiosk, the signed-release updater and the boot-partition files.

components.name: Image build and releases
components.what: Builds Raspberry Pi OS Lite images with RPi ALERT installed (arm64, armhf) in a qemu chroot and publishes them, signed, as a GitHub release on a v<version> tag.

components.name: Set-up site
components.what: GitHub Pages page that picks the Pi, starts Raspberry Pi Imager with this repository and writes the card's settings file; serves os_list.json from the latest release.

components.name: Tests and simulator
components.what: node --test suite with a real off-air burst, protocol vectors, a Flood-Net stand-in, pty receivers and a fake rtl_sdr; simulate.sh runs a base station with no hardware.

provides.name: RPi ALERT release
provides.what: A GitHub release per v<version> tag: SD-card images, Imager entries and a signed agent-and-OS tarball the Pis' updater installs. Flood-Net's Base Stations tab reads the latest tag to offer 'Install the latest release'.

provides.name: Base-station check-in: heartbeat, status and verbs
provides.what: What a Pi sends Flood-Net's base_station_checkin each minute (heartbeat, spectrum rows, whole status, settings without secrets) and the only requests it accepts back: status, log, config.set, device.*, send-now, update.*, agent.restart, reboot, access.sync, recordings.

provides.name: SDR channel planner rules
provides.what: How a stick's window and centre are chosen for its channels: the sample rates (RATES), the usable middle 80% (USABLE), clearance from the DC spike and mirror images. Flood-Net's sdr-pi.js and Base Stations waterfall follow the same rules.

provides.name: ALERT2 AirLink off-air decoder
provides.what: Decodes ALERT2 AirLink frames (4800 bps, with FEC) from an SDR channel. Self-contained, and meant to move into Flood-Net beside alert-dsp.js so the website's SDR card hears ALERT2 too.

provides.name: Set-up site and Imager repository
provides.what: The page that sets up a new base station and writes its rpi-alert.conf, and os_list.json for rpi-imager --repo, built from the latest release.

consumes.what: Flood-Net's off-air ALERT decoder, Quansheng serial codec, ERT-A2 ALERT2 parser and NMEA parser, copied verbatim with the off-air test burst.
consumes.on_change: Run agent/scripts/sync-meganet.sh (copies the files from Flood-Net's main and records the commit in SOURCE), then the agent tests: cd agent && node --test test/*.test.js. Follow any changed shape in the drivers (ert.js, quansheng.js, sdr.js), bump agent/package.json and release.

consumes.what: Flood-Net's HTTPS ingest: ingest_http (readings), report_ingest_point (receivers), report_receptions (every frame heard) and the token request, as RPCs with the X-Ingest-Token header through floodwarning.net's /api/db proxy, or Supabase directly.
consumes.on_change: Check agent/lib/meganet.js, uplink.js and token-request.js against the change, update the stand-in agent/test/helpers/meganet-stub.js, then cd agent && node --test test/*.test.js.

consumes.what: Flood-Net's side of the check-in: the base_station_checkin and base_station_keys RPCs, what they keep (a 16 KB status, a 2 KB heartbeat, spectrum rows) and the config.set patches the Base Stations tab writes.
consumes.on_change: Check agent/lib/remote.js (verbs, status and heartbeat limits, the config.set guards) and docs/remote-management.md against it, then cd agent && node --test test/*.test.js.

consumes.what: Flood-Net's public station register, fetched daily and kept on disk: names what each address is, and offers a stick's channels from the frequencies stations near the Pi use. The set-up page reads it too.
consumes.on_change: If the document's shape changes, update agent/lib/stations.js and site/app.js, then cd agent && node --test test/stations.test.js.

consumes.what: The ALERT receiver firmware's USB serial interface, schema 2: DEC, BST, STA and EVT lines, DTR, TIME and the console. The line codec is Flood-Net's quansheng.js (vendored); the driver adds DTR toggling, clock setting and one command at a time.
consumes.on_change: A record-format change goes into Flood-Net's quansheng.js first and comes here with agent/scripts/sync-meganet.sh; DTR, clock or console changes go in agent/lib/devices/quansheng.js. Then cd agent && node --test test/*.test.js.

consumes.what: The older DP32G030 ALERT firmware's UART line, ALERT,<id>,<value>,<ABF|EIF>,<rssi>,<name> at 38400 over the programming cable: recognised by sniff.js, read by the Quansheng driver's legacy path.
consumes.on_change: Update the LEGACY pattern in agent/lib/devices/quansheng.js and the sniff in agent/lib/devices/sniff.js, then cd agent && node --test test/devices.test.js.

asks.what: Take the ALERT2 AirLink decoder (agent/lib/devices/alert2-air.js, alert2-fec.js) beside alert-dsp.js, so the website's SDR card hears ALERT2 and the Pi can vendor it back.
Map an ALERT2 station's (station, sensor number) to an ALERT id in the register, so self-reporting stations' sensors become readings rather than receptions only.
A channeliser shared by a stick's channels (one filter bank per stick) in alert-dsp.js, or at least a lighter first filter, so a Pi can take a fifth channel.
